svg.title: Pranay Kadu · BackendArchitectX — Pixel Arcade × Matrix Terminal
svg.desc: Backend Software Engineer. Java 8, 11 and 17, Spring Boot, distributed systems, microservices, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, SQL and Redis. A custom pixel robot wakes, assembles servers, launches a deployment rocket and celebrates, while green code rain, a scanner and brief name echoes repeat in a 16-second arcade animation. This is an illustrative animation, not production status. Reduced-motion preferences display a still scene. Full professional details remain in the readable README below.

g.text: Build for failure. Preserve the invariant.
Wake the builder. Load the tools.
Assemble the services. Connect the pieces.
